Overview

A Scandinavian Classic — Built to Last

The Vindö 28 is a beloved piece of Swedish maritime heritage, designed by the renowned naval architect Carl Andersson. This is Hull No. 106, launched in 1963 — a true Scandinavian classic featuring a hand-crafted mahogany hull and teak deck.

The boat has undergone significant structural refurbishment in recent years, making her a solid foundation for a new owner who appreciates wooden boats and classic craftsmanship. She comes with a well-maintained sail inventory and a full set of deck equipment.

Below Decks

Engine

Beta Marine 14 HP Diesel

The Beta Marine 14 HP diesel was installed in 1999. It is currently not operational following a water ingress event (see below) and should be considered a project — either for repair by a diesel specialist or full replacement. See the full disclosure below.

Full Transparency

Known Issues — Disclosed Honestly

Important — Please Read Before Enquiring

In 2024, a cockpit drain pipe failure caused water ingress and a partial sinking. The engine compartment was flooded. The following items require attention by a new owner:

  • Engine was submerged — not been restarted, condition unknown
  • Starter battery failed and needs replacement
  • Bilge pump not working (straightforward replacement)
  • New batteries required throughout
  • Starboard aft railing damaged (visible in photos)

Summary: Structurally solid classic boat. The engine must be considered a project — budget for repair or replacement. All issues are disclosed openly and honestly.
